assumptions.statement: All behavioral coefficients are explicit structural assumptions, not measurements of product superiority.
Token prices and GitHub plan economics are frozen to the public 2026-09-04 snapshot.
Each coupling ID preserves the same latent task, provider load, tool failures, and verifier shocks across scenarios.
Compared scenarios face the same external verifier at each design point.
Uncached input, cache reads, cache writes, and output form separate token ledgers.
Provider-value, marginal-cash, allocated-cash, human-time, SLA, and failure costs remain distinct until economic loss is calculated.
Vendor ecosystem, governance, privacy, negotiation, and user-learning effects are outside the model boundary.

hypotheses.claim: One named harness is categorically most efficient in real production use.
hypotheses.estimand: Real-world difference in verified work per total economic cost across the named products.

analysis.reason: No observed matched-task executions, user learning, ecosystem effects, or organization-specific constraints are present.

hypotheses.decisionRule: Do not rank products in reality from synthetic outcomes; require matched tasks, fixed verifiers, telemetry, and observed human costs.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: A preregistered matched-task field trial whose interval reverses a modeled ordering falsifies any attempted real-world extrapolation.

hypotheses.claim: Pi through GitHub lowers normalized cost per verified work by at least 0.10 relative to Copilot CLI under the declared mechanisms.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in normalized_cost_per_verified_work (pi-cli-copilot-route minus copilot-cli-copilot-route).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Diverse-tool, long-context, and unreliable-tool challenges test whether selection, preservation, or retry mechanics reverse the advantage.

hypotheses.claim: Pi through GitHub is quality-noninferior to Copilot CLI within 0.02 under the declared mechanisms.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in external_quality_score (pi-cli-copilot-route minus copilot-cli-copilot-route).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Compaction and tool-sprawl challenges falsify the claim if their upper interval endpoint is below -0.02.

hypotheses.claim: With Pi and Terra fixed, direct OpenAI routing does not increase normalized provider-ledger cost by more than 0.02.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in normalized_provider_cost (pi-cli-openai-api minus pi-cli-copilot-route).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: A route-specific cache or long-context difference above 0.02 would challenge equivalence.

hypotheses.claim: Before allowance exhaustion, direct API settlement has nonnegative marginal cash cost relative to GitHub subscription settlement.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in marginal_cash_cost_usd_per_task (pi-cli-openai-api minus pi-cli-copilot-route).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Expensive long-context portfolios test whether both routes enter overage and erase the marginal difference.
